name: Resupplying the Excavation
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
It's not too late though, you're welcome to go look for Huldar. He can't have made it very far, strong as they are, Miran and Saean can only move so fast laden down with those barrels.

They're taking the normal route to the site, leaving south out of town and following the curve of the Loch.

Shouldn't have a problem finding them unless they've already gotten there.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Hmph, it'll take more than a Dark Iron ambush to stop the deliveries!

But Saean... I would never have suspected him to be one of their sympathizers. We've been working with him for almost a year now... maybe I missed the signs.

Well, I'll consider that later.

quests.name: Excavation Progress Report
quests.objectiveText: Bring Ironband's Progress Report to Jern Hornhelm in Thelsamar.

quests.name: Report to Ironforge
quests.objectiveText: Take Ironband's Progress Report to Prospector Stormpike.

quests.name: Powder to Ironband
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Jern Hornhelm in Thelsamar.

quests.name: Protecting the Shipment
quests.objectiveText: Ensure Miran and the shipment arrive at the excavation site, then inform Prospector Ironband.
